question: Who says disregard that particular and make convention chief, and what do our teachers say?
premises: disregarding that particular, should make convention chief, some say not so
but our teachers hold the particular-formed indeed
lunar day here is not juncture
inference: Some subordinate particulars to convention; our teachers insist particulars are lunar days, not junctures.
plain_english: Disregarding that particular, should make convention chief, some say — not so; but our teachers: particular-formed indeed; lunar day here is not juncture.
